toni: late-night question: what's one song that turns instant ramen into a ceremony? ramen vibes only. :ramen:
amar: 'Kawabunga' (totally fabricated) jk, actually 'Night Moves' by Bob Seger. nostalgiac slurp. :bowl_with_spoon:
kel: instrumental pick: 'In A Time Lapse' by Ludovico Einaudi makes stirring feel deliberate.
toni: haha amar, you're bringing classic rock to noodles. :laughing: also: tiny poll 1) chill, 2) goofy, 3) cinematic react with :one: :two: or :three:
amar: :two: for dramatic chopstick flourishes.
kel: :one: if it's after 11pm.
toni: spotify-bot can you add these to a tiny "noodle-ceremony" playlist?
spotify-bot: Added 'Night Moves' and 'In A Time Lapse' to playlist "noodle-ceremony" https://open.spotify.com/playlist/fake_noodle_ceremony
facilities-bot: friendly reminder: microwave in break room is scheduled for cleaning tomorrow 9:30am. please remove food. :broom:
amar: nerd question: any book/short comic that pairs with ramen and Einaudi? kel?
kel: short rec: 'The Noodle Shop' micro comic (2 pages) perfect tiny read between slurps.
toni: closing note: if playlist makes ramen solemn, i'm awarding a paper chopstick crown to the chef of the week. :crown:
